action.summary: Thus, $29 \le 5x < 30,$ so \[5.8 \le x < 6.\]Indeed, if $5.8 \le x < 6,$ then $\lfloor x \lfloor x \rfloor \rfloor = \lfloor 5x \rfloor = 29,$ so all $x \in [5.8,6)$ are solutions to the equation.

source.problem: Find all real $x$ such that \[\left\lfloor x \lfloor x \rfloor\right \rfloor = 29.\]
